mapper.select: SELECT * FROM activities ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT * FROM activities WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT * FROM activities WHERE is_published = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activities (title, cover, description, location, lat, lng, start_time, end_time, max_participants, current_participants, status, is_published) VALUES (#{title}, #{cover}, #{description}, #{location}, #{lat}, #{lng}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{maxParticipants}, #{currentParticipants}, #{status}, #{isPublished})
mapper.update: UPDATE activities SET title=#{title}, cover=#{cover}, description=#{description}, location=#{location}, lat=#{lat}, lng=#{lng}, start_time=#{startTime}, end_time=#{endTime}, max_participants=#{maxParticipants}, current_participants=#{currentParticipants}, status=#{status}, is_published=#{isPublished} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE activities SET is_published = #{isPublished} WHERE id = #{id}
